name: nebula-sync
description:
Synchronize Pi-hole v6.x configuration to replicas.

This project is not a part of the official Pi-hole project, but uses the api provided by Pi-hole instances to perform the synchronization actions.

Features
* Full sync: Use Pi-hole Teleporter for full synchronization.
* Manual sync: Selective feature synchronization.
* Cron schedule: Run on chron schedule.

*** REQUIRE PI-HOLE V6 ***
Reminder Pihole V6 is still under heavy development

variables.name: Primary Pi-hole
variables.description:
Specifies the primary Pi-hole configuration
ie: http://ph1.example.com|password

variables.name: Replicas
variables.description:
Specifies the list of replica Pi-hole configurations
ie: http://ph2.example.com|password,http://ph3.example.com|password

variables.name: Sync mode
variables.description:
Specifies whether to perform a full synchronization
can be true or false (aka manual)

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Specifies the timezone for logs and cron

variables.name: Cron schedule
variables.description: Specifies the cron schedule for synchronization
